mutations.name: a build beat is cut at its middle, as the old mid + end - 1 s sheet did
kills: cutCells cuts a 3-row list once, at its settled last frame
cutCells puts no cell inside the beat's entrance or a cue's entrance
cutCells changes no cell when an early beat is lengthened by 2 s (hold)

mutations.name: page marks are ignored
kills: cutCells cuts a beat by its page marks when the page publishes them, and the rest by rule

mutations.name: a step is cut at its settle time even after the next cue starts
kills: cutCells cuts a code walk with 3 cues into the whole view and one cell per focus step

mutations.name: the swap shows its question even when it never settled
kills: cutCells skips the before cell of a swap whose question never settles before the first row
